verdict.rationale: Statsig's own docs say feature flags and 2 million metered events are free, which shows metered events are a cost driver and that a free tier exists. Nothing else in the pack shows published price points or explains how seats, MAUs or requests affect cost. Missing for 10: published pricing page or price-per-unit figures, explanation of paid tiers and overage costs, clarity on whether seats/MAUs/requests factor into billing, independent corroboration of pricing transparency.
